crossRefs.note: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

translations.web: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;
translations.bsb: what He did for you in the wilderness until you reached this place;
translations.kjv: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
translations.asv: and what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came unto this place;
